structuredContent.name: tenants.change-user-role
structuredContent.description: Change the role of an existing member of an active tenant. Allowed for a global administrator or a TenantOwner of the tenant. A user who is not a member is rejected, and setting the role the member already has is accepted and changes nothing. Demoting the last TenantOwner is allowed; afterwards only a global administrator can manage the tenant's members, roles and configuration.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant whose member changes role.

UserId.description: Identifier of the member whose role changes: the subject (sub) claim the identity provider issues for that user.

NewRole.description: Role that replaces the member's current role. Every role can read the tenant and its members; TenantContributor can also update its name and description; TenantOwner can also manage its members, roles and configuration. Unknown is rejected.
